simple.meaning: מָחוֹל (mâchôwl) is a Hebrew word meaning “a (round) dance.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מָחוֹל (H4234) appears 6 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Psalms 30:12, with occurrences in Psalms, Jeremiah, Lamentations.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מָחוֹל (H4234) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מָחוֹל (H4234) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מָחוֹל (mâchôwl) / H4234 is traced through Psalms 30:12, Psalms 149:3, Psalms 150:4, Jeremiah 31:4 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H4234. machol מָחוֺל noun masculine Lam 5:15 dance ; — absolute ׳מ Psa 30:12 3 t.; construct מְחוֺל Jer 31:4 ; מְחוֺלֵנוּ Lam 5:15 ; — dance , token of joyousness Psa 30:12 (opposed to מספד ), Jer 31:4 , 13 (compare v b ), Lam 5:15 (opposed to אֵבֶּל ); act of praise to ׳י Psa 149:3 ; 150:4 ; accompanied by timbrel ( תֹּף ) and sometimes other instruments 149:3 ; 149:4 ; Jer 31:13 .

occurrences.englishText: to the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent.
Let them praise his name in the dance!
Praise him with tambourine and dancing!
Then the virgin will rejoice in the dance;
The joy of our heart has ceased.
